text: The original EWS manual task checks hidden protocol/security/port fields, visible EWS URL/label and discovered field values, then stops at the password step. A separate advanced task confirms account creation and waits for an account by identity email. The ordinary manual task checks the opposite field visibility. These are distinct checkpoints: no allowed-auth-option enumeration, EWS backend-type assertion or successful edited-account authentication follows merely from their comments or task names. Current accepted flow has later subviews; these are historical test contracts, not a claim that the old IDs still define current UI. No tests ran.
title: Original EWS manual tests separate form visibility from advanced account creation
